channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, Africa, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 06 Jul 2026 (06 Jul to 12 Jul 2026).

  • Heart2World Publishing: Heart2World Book Prize 2026 (Inaugural, Poetry)
    Heart2World Publishing · deadline Closed 05 Aug 2026 · NGN 250,000 cash prize, a full publishing and marketing package (valued at approximately NGN 5 million), and 100 percent net royalties on the published colle...
  • RCDIJ Africa Fund: Data and Investigative Journalism Grants
    Ripples Centre for Data and Investigative Journalism (RCDIJ) · deadline Rolling / undated · Grants ranging from under USD 1,000 up to USD 10,000, plus editorial support and publication. No application fee.
